objective: Enable WEDGE6 Newmark and harmonic routes without changing the FEM formulation, then validate the enablement with pure micro-runs and a connected mixed smoke.

root_cause.before: WEDGE6 supported_analyses contained only linear_static and modal; the generic router was present but preflight stopped the model with ANALYSIS_NOT_SUPPORTED.
root_cause.dispatch_assessment: The Newmark and harmonic solvers already dispatch generically after preflight; no separate WEDGE6 numerical dispatch branch was required.

preflight.policy: The routes are technically executable but remain experimental/internal candidates; no maturity or 46-combination registry record was added.

enablement.scope: WEDGE6 isotropic_3d, small-system generic Newmark/harmonic paths only; full mixed V&V remains WP13-02B/02C.
enablement.failure_contract: Unsupported material, load, geometry or analysis input still fails explicitly; no family substitution or silent backend fallback was introduced.

pure_wedge6_newmark.model: One WEDGE6, fixed lower triangular face, first dense K/M mode as initial displacement, zero external load, zero Rayleigh damping.
pure_wedge6_newmark.oracle: Independent dense generalized K/M eigenpair and closed-form first-mode oscillator; no production Newmark loop reused.
pure_wedge6_newmark.interpretation: Coarse levels are retained as convergence characterization; the frozen 1% amplitude/RMS and 0.02 rad phase gates pass at the declared fine levels 80 and 160. This is a route smoke, not a qualification decision.

pure_wedge6_harmonic.model: One WEDGE6, fixed lower triangular face, unit nodal UZ load at node 4, 2% first-mode mass-proportional damping.
pure_wedge6_harmonic.oracle: Independent dense complex reduced solve at every frequency using K+i*omega*C-omega^2*M.

mixed_smoke.interface_transfer: SMOKE_PASS through shared-node generic assembly; no family was dropped.
mixed_smoke.note: This is dispatch/assembly smoke evidence only; mixed dynamic amplitude/phase and full interface V&V remain 02B/02C.
